theorems.name: Submission.dpf_pfc_testFormOnConverges_zero_uniform
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (ωs : ℕ → TestFormOn U n), TestFormOnConverges ωs 0 → ∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ U ∧ (∀ j x, x ∉ C → (ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = 0) ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ j in atTop, ∀ x, ‖(ωs j : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x‖ ≤ ε
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
